description:
Recently the pastor of Hastings SDA Church (@HastingsSDAChurch), Jeff Dowell, began a series of presentations seeking to refute my presentation titled "In Defense of the First Day Sabbath" wherein I gave a redemptive historical analysis of the Christian sabbath position. Mr. Dowell utterly face plants and provides us with a number of opportunities to help connect the dots for Christians as well as help clarify for Mr. Dowell why he needs to better study that which he criticizes before claiming to easily refute it and mislead other people in the process.
